_README: Copy to athlete/constants.json and fill during intake. Every athlete-specific number the code needs lives here — nothing in scripts/ or src/ may hardcode a value about the athlete. The validator requires the fields marked REQUIRED and will fail the build without them.

athlete._sex_REQUIRED: "male" or "female". Input to the Mifflin-St Jeor RMR equation ONLY: male adds +5, female subtracts 161 — a 166 kcal/day difference that is invisible on screen if wrong. It is used for nothing else. If no domain needs energy expenditure, it still must be set for the validator; the number simply goes unused.
athlete._dob_REQUIRED: YYYY-MM. Year-month is enough — age moves RMR by 5 kcal/year, so day precision would be false precision. Age is derived, never stored, so it cannot go stale.

baseline._comment: Set once, at intake, from the protocol in skills/intake Session 6. weightLb is REQUIRED by the validator even on charts with no body-composition domain — RMR needs it.

plan._comment: Current phase parameters. Only fill what this athlete's domains actually need — a chart with no energy domain does not need a calorie budget, and inventing one is the failure CLAUDE.md 1.1 exists to prevent. estMaintenanceKcal and proteinFloorG are validator-required.
plan._max_rate_note: CLAUDE.md section 5 hard floor. Do not raise it.

triggers._comment: Machine-readable mirror of the trigger values in athlete/goals.md, so the dashboard can draw reference lines. goals.md is authoritative for the reasoning; if the two disagree, goals.md wins and this is the bug. Key names are per-athlete — whatever this chart's domains measure.

events._comment: Dated things worth counting down to: a trip, a procedure, an event the plan is built around.

metOverrides._comment: Optional per-athlete MET values overriding the defaults in scripts/lib/athlete.mjs. Walking must stay 0 — its energy is already counted in steps.

metrics._comment: Registry for anything tracked in data/metrics.csv — the long-format file for measures the fixed columns of body.csv don't cover. Every entry must name its unit, its direction (up|down = which way is progress), and the goals.md domain it serves. The validator rejects an entry with no domain, because a metric no domain needs is a chore the coach invented.
